questions.prompt: A dentist uses a concave mirror with f = 2 cm held 1.5 cm from a tooth. Find the position and nature of the image, and explain why this helps the dentist.
questions.modelAnswer: u = −1.5 cm, f = −2 cm. 1/v = 1/f − 1/u = −1/2 + 1/1.5 = 1/6, so v = +6 cm. The image is 6 cm behind the mirror: virtual and upright. m = −v/u = −6/−1.5 = +4, so it is magnified four times, letting the dentist see the tooth clearly.
